characters.continuity: The Matrix (1999 film) and its sequels, plus The Matrix comic series
characters.summary: Morpheus is a master martial artist, skilled firearms combatant, and charismatic rebel leader of the Nebuchadnezzar. Within the Matrix, he manipulates code to perform superhuman feats, while in the real world he operates heavy machinery and combat vessels.

mechanisms: Matrix code distortion to dodge attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to Agent possession and override in the Matrix
Physical vulnerability in the real world
mobility: Superhuman running and leaping inside the Matrix
limitations: Physical body remains in the real world while hooked into the Matrix

sources.supports: Morpheus character profile, martial arts capabilities, and role as captain of the Nebuchadnezzar.

feats.claim: Fought an Agent on top of a moving semi-truck trailer, demonstrating peak human-plus agility and combat skill inside the Matrix.

notableResults.note: Captured by Agents inside the Matrix after a fierce battle.

characters.summary: Ms. Perkins is a ruthless and efficient contract killer operating within the Continental hotel network, utilizing stealth, firearms, and close-quarters combat.
weaknesses: Subject to the rules of the Continental
limitations: Bound by the rules of the Continental hotel (no business on hotel grounds)

sources.supports: Ms. Perkins role as an assassin hunting John Wick for a bounty.

feats.claim: Infiltrated a safehouse room to ambush and kill Marcus while he slept.

notableResults.note: Outmatched and executed for breaking Continental rules.

characters.summary: Murron MacClannough is a courageous Scottish woman whose execution by English authorities catalyzes the Scottish rebellion led by her secret husband, William Wallace.
weaknesses: Lacks combat training or weapons, leaving her vulnerable to armed soldiers
limitations: Ordinary human capabilities without military combat skills

sources.supports: Murron MacClannough character background and role in the film.

feats.claim: Resisted attempted assault by English soldiers in public, inspiring local defiance.

characters.summary: Nathan Algren is a disillusioned American Civil War veteran and cavalry captain who masters traditional samurai swordsmanship and tactics while fighting alongside the rebel samurai.
mobility: Horseback riding and standard foot movement

sources.supports: Nathan Algren background as a veteran and training with the samurai.

feats.claim: Defended a village against ninja assassins in a nighttime raid using melee weapons.

notableResults.note: Led samurai defense in battle against modern artillery and rifles.

characters.continuity: The Matrix (1999 film) and its sequels, plus The Matrix comic series
characters.summary: Neo is the One, an awakened human inside the Matrix with godlike abilities to manipulate code, fly, stop bullets, and bend physical laws, alongside martial arts mastery.

mechanisms: Invulnerability to standard ballistic damage inside the Matrix

weaknesses: Vulnerable in the physical real world
limitations: Powers are fully active only within the simulated Matrix environment

sources.supports: Neo abilities as the One, flight, and combat feats within the Matrix.

feats.claim: Stopped a barrage of bullets mid-air and crushed an Agent's form inside the Matrix.

notableResults.note: Defeated Agent Smith after resurrecting as the One.

campaignTags.claim: Flies at supersonic speeds within the Matrix.
Innate ability to fly in the Matrix without devices.

characters.summary: Nux is an enthusiastic War Boy who transitions from Immortan Joe's fanatic cultist to a dedicated ally of Furiosa, utilizing vehicular combat and self-sacrificial resolve.
limitations: Dependent on blood bags and medical maintenance

sources.supports: Nux character profile, War Boy background, and redemption arc.

feats.claim: Sacrificed his vehicle to block the canyon pass and save Furiosa's convoy.

notableResults.note: Defected and helped defeat the Citadel pursuers.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots and drives modified war rigs and interceptors.

characters.summary: O-Ren Ishii, also known as Cottonmouth, is the ruthless leader of the Tokyo Yakuza, wielding a master-crafted Hattori Hanzo sword with deadly precision in close-quarters combat.
weaknesses: Arrogance in her own sword skill superiority
mobility: Agile acrobatics and foot movement in snow environments

sources.supports: O-Ren Ishii background as a Tokyo underworld boss and swordfighter.

feats.claim: Decapitated Boss Tanaka during a Yakuza leadership meeting with a single swift sword strike.

notableResults.note: Defeated in a snowy Japanese garden duel.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to multiple armed attackers in close quarters without cover
limitations: Human physical body susceptible to blunt trauma and lacerations
